shots.subject: a cave mouth at first light, the rock floor worn smooth by long use
a cairn of small stones on a ridge, the top one not yet placed
five ochre hand prints on a cave wall, palms outward, at arm's height

shots.chapter: Week 2 — Fox and Konner, why we play
shots.subject: a rope swing over a river, still swinging, nobody on it
a spear thrower propped against a rock, the notch at its end worn pale
a knapped hand axe and a length of braided cord laid side by side on cloth
one river from the air, braiding into many channels and rejoining downstream
an hourglass on a stone sill, the sand very nearly through
still water in a rock pool holding the sky, broken by a single drop
a cave mouth at dusk, the light going, the floor still holding warmth
